situations.headline: AWJ trading halt pending material acquisition announcement

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: AWJ trading halt pending material acquisition announcement (interest 5, risk 5)

thesis.text: Auric Mining is in the process of announcing a material acquisition, disclosed only via a trading halt request as of 7 September 2026; no target, terms, or financing details are yet public. The company file should be monitored closely once the acquisition announcement is released (expected by 9 September 2026) to assess deal quality, dilution risk, and strategic fit before forming a directional view.
